charter.objective: Explore many GPU-native ways for exact genomic information to build and refine hierarchical learned representations.
charter.motivation: Replace the deferred BitOp roadmap with a broader implementation-first workshop while preserving successful substrate and negative evidence.
charter.desired_end_state: Diverse concrete experimental mechanisms, several compositions, source-grounded interfaces, and an honest later-qualification inventory.
boundaries: This plan writes Baseplane only; the paired Cellerator plan owns experimental learned/numerical providers from inception. Neither authority silently writes the other.
Maintain source validity, strand, provenance, explicit buffer capacities and Volta synchronization.
Broad isolated experimentation is authorized; production promotion and broad benchmarks are not.
Preserve completed old tasks, lab findings and retained work. The reviewed supersession protocol is required before claiming this run.
acceptance_conditions: Each catalogue item has a truthful disposition and artifact or explicit defer/reject reason; seeds are not reported as completed architectures.
Representative mechanisms can be built/run in their declared environments or are explicitly marked uncompiled; minimal correctness checks only.
No silent dropped work, no hidden oracle candidate input, no unbounded memory/queue construction.
charter.delegated_judgment: Use dependency-driven parallel family lanes after foundation integration. Dispatch bounded configured Codex subagents under the root claim and file ownership; the root retains lifecycle and acceptance. Lane count is potential independence, not agent capacity: obey the total active agent budget including root and any heads. Shared seams have one owner; integrate family patches before compositions and closure.
